groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729 (Cartwright Act, as amended by AB 325)
groups.interaction: General antitrust ban on coordinated pricing algorithms; complements city-specific algorithmic rent-setting ordinances (e.g., Berkeley, San Francisco, San Diego, Santa Ana) which impose parallel, housing-specific prohibitions.

groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 (FEHA source-of-income protection, as amended by SB 329/SB 267)
groups.interaction: Operates alongside local source-of-income ordinances (e.g., Los Angeles Mun. Code §45.67) that provide overlapping or additional protections.

groups.canonical_citation: 2 Cal. Code Regs. §§ 12260 et seq. (Civil Rights Council criminal history screening regulations)
groups.conflict_note: Citation for the underlying regulatory authority is inferred from secondary sources; no specific CCR section number is quoted in the record.
groups.interaction: Complements stricter local criminal-history ordinances such as Berkeley's Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance.

groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.6
groups.conflict_note: Base $30 cap (1998) is adjusted annually for inflation; current cap is $68.96 for 2026 per one source.
groups.interaction: Applies statewide; Berkeley requires landlords to additionally disclose this state cap to applicants (Berkeley Mun. Code §13.78.010).

groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5
groups.conflict_note: A 2025 amendment (AB 414) effective Jan. 1, 2026 further bars 'nonrefundable' deposit clauses and adds itemization/return rules on top of the base cap.
groups.interaction: Applies statewide to deposit caps and return procedures; rent-controlled jurisdictions like Berkeley and San Francisco add deposit-interest requirements on top of this cap.

groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12 (Tenant Protection Act of 2019 / AB 1482)
groups.conflict_note: Statute is repealed as of Jan. 1, 2030; operative date differs from original enactment date.
groups.interaction: Does not apply to units covered by a local rent control ordinance (e.g., Berkeley, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Santa Ana), which govern instead.

groups.canonical_citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2
groups.conflict_note: Operative date differs across amendments (2020-01-01 original; 2024-04-01 current operative text); self-repeals Jan. 1, 2030.
groups.interaction: Does not apply where a qualifying local just-cause ordinance adopted on or before Sept. 1, 2019, or a more protective local ordinance adopted after that date, governs instead (e.g., Berkeley, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, Santa Ana).

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.63
groups.interaction: Overlaps with the state Cartwright Act ban on coordinated pricing algorithms (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §16729); city ordinance adds local enforcement and per-violation penalties.

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.106 (Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance)
groups.interaction: Provides stronger criminal-history protections than the state Civil Rights Council regulations.

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause/Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB)
groups.conflict_note: Berkeley's just-cause ordinance predates Sept. 1, 2019, exempting it from the state Tenant Protection Act, but subsequent Measure BB amendments (2024) must still qualify as 'more protective' to retain that exemption.
groups.interaction: State just-cause rule (Civil Code §1946.2) yields to this local ordinance for units it covers.

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code §13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
groups.conflict_note: State rent cap (AB 1482) does not apply to units subject to this local rent control.
groups.interaction: State rent cap (AB 1482) yields to this local rent-control ordinance for covered units in Berkeley.

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
groups.interaction: Supplements the state security deposit cap (Civil Code §1950.5) with an additional interest-payment requirement for rent-controlled units.

groups.canonical_citation: Berkeley Mun. Code §§13.78.010, 13.78.016
groups.interaction: Requires disclosure of the state screening fee cap (Civil Code §1950.6) and adds local restrictions on non-refundable fees for existing tenants.

groups.canonical_citation: L.A.M.C. §§151.09, 165.03, 165.05, 165.06 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance & Just Cause Ordinance)
groups.conflict_note: LA's RSO/JCO ordinances predate Sept. 2019, exempting covered units from the state Tenant Protection Act's just-cause rule.
groups.interaction: State just-cause rule (Civil Code §1946.2) yields to this local ordinance for units it covers.

groups.canonical_citation: L.A.M.C. §151.06 (Rent Stabilization Ordinance)
groups.conflict_note: State rent cap (AB 1482) does not apply to units subject to this local rent control.
groups.interaction: State rent cap (AB 1482) yields to this local rent-control ordinance for covered units in Los Angeles.
Adds an interest-payment requirement on security deposits for RSO-covered units, supplementing the state deposit cap.
Overlaps with state FEHA source-of-income protections (Gov. Code §12955), providing additional local enforcement.

groups.canonical_citation: San Diego Mun. Code ch. 9, art. 8, div. 7 (§§98.0700-98.0707)
groups.conflict_note: Adopted after Sept. 1, 2019, so this local ordinance must meet the state 'more protective' standard under Civil Code §1946.2 to govern in place of state law; the ordinance text states its purpose is to be 'consistent with' the state statute.
groups.interaction: Supplements the state just-cause law with added relocation assistance and notice requirements.

groups.canonical_citation: San Diego Mun. Code §§98.1101-98.1104
groups.conflict_note: An earlier draft/staff report described the ordinance as pending (blank final-passage date); it has since been enacted and codified.
groups.interaction: Complements the state Cartwright Act ban on algorithmic pricing collusion with a San Diego-specific prohibition and private right of action.

groups.canonical_citation: S.F. Admin. Code §37.9 et seq. (Rent Ordinance)
groups.conflict_note: San Francisco's just-cause ordinance predates Sept. 2019, exempting it from the state Tenant Protection Act's just-cause rule.
groups.interaction: State just-cause rule (Civil Code §1946.2) yields to this local ordinance for units it covers.

groups.canonical_citation: S.F. Admin. Code §37.3
groups.conflict_note: State rent cap (AB 1482) does not apply to units subject to this local rent control.
groups.interaction: State rent cap (AB 1482) yields to this local rent-control ordinance for covered units in San Francisco.

groups.canonical_citation: S.F. Admin. Code §37.10C
groups.interaction: Complements the state Cartwright Act ban on algorithmic pricing collusion with a rent-ordinance-specific prohibition and private right of action.

groups.canonical_citation: S.F. Admin. Code §37.9A(e)
groups.interaction: Adds an interest-payment requirement on security deposits on top of the state deposit cap.

groups.canonical_citation: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance
groups.interaction: Supplements state Civil Rights Council criminal-history regulations with protections specific to affordable housing in San Francisco.

groups.canonical_citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code, Rent Stabilization Ordinance
groups.conflict_note: State rent cap (AB 1482) does not apply to units subject to this local rent control.
groups.interaction: State rent cap (AB 1482) yields to this local rent-control ordinance for covered units in Santa Ana.

groups.canonical_citation: Santa Ana Mun. Code, Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
groups.conflict_note: Adopted after Sept. 1, 2019, so this local ordinance must be at least as protective as the state Tenant Protection Act to exempt covered units from the state just-cause rule.
groups.interaction: Operates in place of the state just-cause rule for covered units if sufficiently protective; otherwise state law may apply.

groups.canonical_citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance (Registration Fee Pass-Through Cap)
Santa Ana Mun. Code (Algorithmic Rent-Setting Ordinance)
groups.conflict_note: An earlier source described the ordinance as pending final vote (scheduled Mar. 3, 2026); it has since been enacted, though exact effective date varies slightly across secondary sources.
groups.interaction: Complements the state Cartwright Act ban on algorithmic pricing collusion with a Santa Ana-specific prohibition and private right of action.
